description: This file defines a Java interface 'SourceBuilder' which provides a fluent API for building instances of 'Source' objects, allowing configuration of various attributes such as addresses, qos, authorization, acknowledgements, and reply settings.

classes.name: SourceBuilder
classes.description: A Java interface providing a fluent API for constructing 'Source' objects with configurable parameters such as addresses, qos, acknowledgements, authorization, and reply target.

methods.name: addresses
methods.description: Sets multiple addresses for the source, returning the builder for chaining.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Adds a single address to the source.

methods.name: consumerCount
methods.description: Sets the number of consumers for the source.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets the index position of the source within a connection.

methods.name: qos
methods.description: Sets the Quality of Service level, nullable.

methods.name: authorizationContext
methods.description: Sets the authorization context for the source.

methods.name: acknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Sets acknowledgement requests with optional filtering.

methods.name: payloadMapping
methods.description: Defines payload mappings for the source.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a 'Source' instance with the configured parameters.
